summary: Russian forces launched a massive coordinated wave of reactive UAVs and Geran-5 missiles from Primorsko-Akhtarsk, Crimea, and Bryansk region across northern, central, and western Ukraine, striking Kyiv's critical Nivky substation causing widespread power outages and metro suspension. Simultaneous attacks hit energy, commercial, and civilian infrastructure in at least ten oblasts, killing at least seven civilians including three TEC workers in Kramatorsk, three on the Kyiv-Odesa highway, and an infant with two women in Kharkiv region. Ukrainian drones struck Russia's Nikolskoye LPDS in Tambov region, a key Druzhba pipeline node, causing a large fire and diesel tank explosions. (Source: eRadarrua/124957, UkraineNow/84785, UkraineNow/84790, UkraineNow/84791, eRadarrua/124885, eRadarrua/124964)
key_points: Russian drone attack on Kyiv's Nivky substation caused fire, power outages in multiple districts, and suspension of metro and funicular services. (Source: eRadarrua/124957)
Drone strike on Kyiv-Odesa highway in Fastiv district killed three, injured four, burned vehicles, and restricted traffic. (Source: UkraineNow/84785)
Russian strike on Kramatorsk TEC killed three workers inspecting heating networks ahead of the heating season. (Source: UkraineNow/84790)
Hypermarkets 'OLDI' in Zhytomyr and two 'Epicentr' in Kovel (Volyn) and Dubno (Rivne) were attacked and temporarily closed. (Source: UkraineNow/84790)
Ukrainian drones struck Nikolskoye LPDS in Tambov region (Russia), a strategic node of the Druzhba oil pipeline, causing a massive fire and diesel tank explosions. (Source: eRadarrua/124885)
Massive UAV launch detected: four groups from Primorsko-Akhtarsk and two reactive groups from Crimea. (Source: eRadarrua/124964)

Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shaheds launched from Bryansk, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Volyn, Dnipropetrovsk, Crimea, and Black Sea toward multiple Ukrainian regions. (Source: mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327)
Budanov stated tough peace negotiations underway in Oslo, denied Russian capture of Dobropillia, confirming Ukrainian control. (Source: UkraineNow/84793)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched a massive coordinated wave of reactive UAVs and Geran-5 missiles from Primorsko-Akhtarsk, Crimea, and Bryansk region across northern, central, and western Ukraine, striking Kyiv's critical Nivky substation causing widespread power outages and metro suspension. Simultaneous attacks hit energy, commercial, and civilian infrastructure in at least ten oblasts, killing at least seven civilians including three TEC workers in Kramatorsk, three on the Kyiv-Odesa highway, and an infant with two women in Kharkiv region. Ukrainian drones struck Russia's Nikolskoye LPDS in Tambov region, a key Druzhba pipeline node, causing a large fire and diesel tank explosions.

points: Ukrainian strike drones targeted the Nikolskoye linear production dispatch station (LPDS) in Michurinsky district, Tambov region, a strategic node of the Druzhba oil pipeline, causing a multi-hour fire and ignition of diesel fuel reservoirs, confirmed by regional authorities. (Source: eRadarrua/124885)

Air defense units engaged reactive UAVs and Geran-5 missiles across Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Volyn, and Lviv regions, with multiple launch groups tracked from Russian territory. (Source: eRadarrua/124882, eRadarrua/124904, eRadarrua/124911, mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327)

Kyiv's air defense operated throughout the day; a reactive UAV was intercepted near Dimer en route to Kyiv, while others approached Boryspil, Rzhyshchiv, Bila Tserkva, and Vyshhorod. (Source: kpszsu/88873, kpszsu/88890, kpszsu/88891, mon1tor_ua/77308)

Budanov led Ukrainian delegation to Oslo for tough peace negotiations, explicitly denying Russian claims of capturing Dobropillia and stating the city remains under Ukrainian control. (Source: UkraineNow/84793)

Zelensky traveled to Norway for talks with Witkoff and European representatives organized by Norway and Finland, aiming to discuss war termination; Witkoff to proceed to Moscow afterward. (Source: UkraineNow/84786)

DBR served suspicion notice to a Lviv TCC serviceman for beating a mobilized man to death, facing up to 10 years imprisonment; investigators identifying all involved TCC personnel. (Source: UkraineNow/84788)

Russian forces launched at least four UAV groups from Primorsko-Akhtarsk and two reactive groups from Crimea, alongside Geran-5 missiles from Bryansk region, targeting Ukrainian energy and civilian infrastructure across a broad front. (Source: eRadarrua/124964, mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291)

Strikes hit Kyiv's Nivky substation (key high-voltage node), causing fire, emergency de-energization, metro/funicular stoppage, and power loss in multiple districts; emergency services working to stabilize grid. (Source: eRadarrua/124957)

Attacks on civilian/commercial targets: Fastiv district highway (3 dead, 4 injured), Kramatorsk TEC (3 workers killed), Zhytomyr OLDI hypermarket, two Epicentr hypermarkets in Kovel (Volyn) and Dubno (Rivne), Dubno railway station, and a park in Kharkiv region (infant and two women killed). (Source: UkraineNow/84785, UkraineNow/84790, UkraineNow/84791, mon1tor_ua/77324)

Reactive UAVs and Geran-5 missiles launched from occupied territories: Bryansk region toward Chernihiv (Chernihiv district), Chernihiv region toward Kyiv (Vyshhorod district) and Zhytomyr (Korosten district), Kyiv region toward Zhytomyr, Zhytomyr region toward Rivne (Sarny, Rivne districts) and Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivka district), Dnipropetrovsk region toward Poltava (Bilyky, Lubny) and Pavlohrad, Crimea toward Black Sea, Black Sea toward Mykolaiv (Ribakivka), Kherson region toward Mykolaiv (Bashtanka district), Kirovohrad region toward Mykolaiv (Voznesensk) and Vinnytsia (Haisyn), Volyn toward Lviv (Zolochiv district). (Source: mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327, kpszsu/88868, kpszsu/88877, kpszsu/88884, kpszsu/88898, kpszsu/88900)

Russia recruited over 46,000 foreign nationals from 151 countries into its armed forces in the first nine months of 2026, exceeding total 2025 recruitment, per Coordination Headquarters for POW Affairs. (Source: UkraineNow/84794)

Khabarovsk abolished direct mayoral elections, leaving only two regional centers in Russia with direct elections; city duma deputies will now choose mayor upon governor's nomination. (Source: eRadarrua/124920)

Russian strike on Kramatorsk thermal power plant (TEC) killed three municipal workers who were inspecting heating networks for the upcoming heating season, per city military administration head Honcharuk. (Source: UkraineNow/84790)
Budanov denied Russian claims of capturing Dobropillia, stating the city remains under Ukrainian control and that Russian statements do not correspond to reality. (Source: UkraineNow/84793)

Reactive UAVs from Dnipropetrovsk region targeted Pavlohrad and Tomakivka areas, moving toward Poltava region (Bilyky, Lubny) and Kyiv region. (Source: kpszsu/88881, kpszsu/88877, kpszsu/88884, kpszsu/88898)
Zaporizhzhia region: UAVs bypassed Komyshuvakha and Vilnyansk moving westward. (Source: kpszsu/88868)

Reactive UAVs from Bryansk region flew north into Chernihiv region (Chernihiv district); Geran-5 missiles from Bryansk also targeted Chernihiv region. (Source: kpszsu/88896, mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327)

Chernihiv region UAVs launched toward Kyiv region (Vyshhorod district, Slavutych) and Zhytomyr region (Korosten district); multiple groups detected. (Source: eRadarrua/124882, eRadarrua/124904, eRadarrua/124911, kpszsu/88864, kpszsu/88886, kpszsu/88900, mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327)

Kyiv region: reactive UAVs headed toward Boryspil, Rzhyshchiv, Bila Tserkva, Vyshhorod, and Kyiv city; one intercepted near Dimer. (Source: kpszsu/88865, kpszsu/88890, kpszsu/88891, kpszsu/88873, mon1tor_ua/77308, eRadarrua/124907)

Zhytomyr region: reactive UAVs moved toward Ovruch and Korosten district; also launched toward Rivne and Khmelnytskyi regions. (Source: kpszsu/88864, kpszsu/88886, mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327)

UAVs from Black Sea aquatory targeted Mykolaiv region (Ribakivka); from Kherson region toward Mykolaiv (Bashtanka district); from Kirovohrad region toward Mykolaiv (Voznesensk district) and Vinnytsia (Haisyn district). (Source: kpszsu/88888, mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327)
Reactive UAVs from Crimea targeted Black Sea aquatory; two reactive groups launched from Crimea per launch detection. (Source: eRadarrua/124964, mon1tor_ua/77313)
Odesa region: reactive UAV north of Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi moving toward Vinnytsia region. (Source: kpszsu/88900)
Mykolaiv region UAVs also targeted Kirovohrad region (Kropyvnytskyi district). (Source: mon1tor_ua/77327)

Massive multi-axis UAV/missile attack: four launch groups from Primorsko-Akhtarsk, two reactive groups from Crimea; Geran-5 missiles from Bryansk, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Volyn, Dnipropetrovsk regions; reactive Shaheds from Crimea, Black Sea, Odesa, Kirovohrad, Kherson, Mykolaiv, Volyn, Dnipropetrovsk, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kyiv regions. (Source: eRadarrua/124964, mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327)

Kyiv air defense engaged throughout day; Nivky substation hit causing fire, power outages, metro/funicular suspension; reactive UAV intercepted near Dimer; others tracked toward Boryspil, Rzhyshchiv, Bila Tserkva, Vyshhorod. (Source: eRadarrua/124957, kpszsu/88873, kpszsu/88890, kpszsu/88891, kpszsu/88865, mon1tor_ua/77308, eRadarrua/124907)

Reactive Shaheds and Geran-5s crisscrossed northern/central Ukraine: Chernihiv→Kyiv (Vyshhorod), Kyiv→Zhytomyr (Korosten), Zhytomyr→Rivne (Sarny, Rivne), Zhytomyr→Khmelnytskyi (Shepetivka), Dnipropetrovsk→Poltava (Bilyky, Lubny), Dnipropetrovsk→Pavlohrad, Volyn→Lviv (Zolochiv), Kirovohrad→Mykolaiv (Voznesensk) and Vinnytsia (Haisyn), Crimea→Black Sea, Black Sea→Mykolaiv (Ribakivka), Kherson→Mykolaiv (Bashtanka), Mykolaiv→Kirovohrad (Kropyvnytskyi). (Source: mon1tor_ua/77313, mon1tor_ua/77291, mon1tor_ua/77327, kpszsu/88881, kpszsu/88884, kpszsu/88898, kpszsu/88900)

Ukrainian strike drones hit Nikolskoye LPDS in Tambov region (Russia), a strategic Druzhba pipeline node, causing large fire and diesel tank explosions; attack lasted several hours. (Source: eRadarrua/124885)

Air raid alerts active across Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Volyn, Lviv, Kirovohrad, Sumy regions. (Source: eRadarrua/124882, eRadarrua/124904, eRadarrua/124911, eRadarrua/124956)

sections.threat_assessment: The coordinated multi-axis attack demonstrates Russia's capacity to saturate Ukrainian air defenses across a vast geographic area, simultaneously targeting critical energy infrastructure (Nivky substation), civilian transit (Fastiv highway), industrial facilities (Kramatorsk TEC), and commercial centers. The use of reactive UAVs and Geran-5 missiles launched from both Russian territory (Bryansk, Primorsko-Akhtarsk) and occupied territories (Crimea, Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk) indicates a matured launch infrastructure. Ukraine's successful strike on the Nikolskoye LPDS in Tambov region, a strategic node of the Druzhba pipeline, signals growing long-range strike capability against Russian energy logistics. The high civilian casualty toll in a single night across multiple oblasts suggests an intentional campaign to degrade civilian morale and infrastructure resilience ahead of winter.
sections.regional_response: Poland's discovery of mass graves of Ukrainians in Laskow (1944) underscores historical tensions but is unrelated to current operations. Lithuania's loss of the 2027 Modern Pentathlon World Cup over refusal to admit Russian/Belarusian athletes reflects ongoing sports diplomacy pressure. US Vice President Vance's statement that Ukraine should not join NATO and must cease strikes on Russian energy infrastructure signals a potential shift in US policy parameters. Republican threats to block the $350 billion Pentagon budget unless Trump hardens policy on Russia indicate domestic political constraints on sustained support. Norway and Finland facilitating Zelensky-Witkoff talks shows Nordic diplomatic engagement in peace efforts.
sections.intelligence_notes: The simultaneous tracking of UAVs crisscrossing northern Ukraine (Chernihiv→Kyiv→Zhytomyr→Rivne/Khmelnytskyi) suggests either deliberate routing to confuse air defense or multiple independent launch platforms. The presence of a Ukrainian UAV near Chernihiv acknowledged by eRadarrua as potentially "ours" but warned to be treated as hostile if identified as enemy indicates fratricide risks in dense airspace. The DBR investigation into Lviv TCC killing reveals internal disciplinary issues within mobilization enforcement. Russia's recruitment of 46,000 foreigners in nine months (151 countries) indicates a systematic effort to offset manpower losses without further domestic mobilization. Khabarovsk's abolition of direct mayoral elections continues the trend of centralizing regional political control.
